Sanskrit vatah "enclosure,"vrnoti “covers,wraps,shuts;"Lithuanian užveriu, užverti "to shut, to close;" Old Persian *pari-varaka "protective;" Latin(op)erire “to cover,"(ap)erire “open,uncover”(with ap-"off, away”);Old Church Slavonic vora "sealed,closed,"vreti"shut;"Old Irish feronn "field,"properly“enclosed land;"Old English wer “dam,fence, enclosure,"German Wehr “defense,protection,”Gothic warjan “to defend, protect."
words.etymology: 耳曼语族中的w 在罗曼语系中会变为g(u) 。 来 自wer-, 保护，防 御，词源同warrant 。 原指城堡守卫，后指卫戍部队。史前日耳曼语 笔 记 区 war- (看管；看护)产生了warjan ( 保护；防护),被古法语(属于 罗曼语系)借用为garir, 派生了garison ( 保护；防护),被英语借用 为garrison。
